    Grading a path-category quotient by homogeneous relations #

    A family of homogeneous relations generates a homogeneous two-sided ideal. The categorical quotient therefore inherits the path-length grading by taking the images of the source components. Composition adds degrees in the quotient, and degree zero is unchanged.
